structured.answer: Open an account at פסגות and buy אי.בי.אי. מחקה ת"א 125 (4A). The page says that leaves 86,045 ₪ after 10 years, after fees and tax, on 70,000 ₪ paid in. That's with the page's default 10,000 ₪ now plus 500 ₪ a month at 7%; I didn't get a figure for my own 30,000.

stuck.why: Every fund has a minus: my chosen one shows −0.04%, the others −1,030 ₪ to −1,733 ₪. It looked like losing money until I caught the small note at the bottom.
Suddenly the 'starting point' is הראל סל at ירושלים with 79,910 ₪, and פסגות shows 84,932 ₪ instead of 86,045 ₪. I didn't know which number was right. This is where I'd have closed the page.
They were set to 10,000 ₪ and 500 ₪ a month. I couldn't put in my 30,000, so the final figure isn't for my amount.

findings.what: Different final numbers for the same account: 86,045 ₪ at the top, 84,932 ₪ for פסגות in the lower table, plus a new 'starting point' of 79,910 ₪. I don't know which to believe
Minus signs on every fund, including the recommended one (−0.04%). It looks like a loss
Every bank repeats the 'לא בחישוב' box and the same coloured bar, so I had to reread each row to find what was different
The colour key is far from the bars, so I had to scroll up and down to match the colours
The calculation starts from 10,000 + 500 and not from my own amount
Too many charts and tables after the decision, which wears you out
